contentPattern.structure: 3 cards, each with image (3:2) + heading + paragraph; borderless

suitableFor: style or trend category showcases with image + title + description
landing page feature sections (3 or 4 columns)
simple card grids without borders, tags, or dates
notSuitableFor: article listings with category tags/dates (use cards-article)
image-only galleries with no text (use cards-gallery)
